name: window_and_tie_boundaries
title: Exact boundaries follow the contract
invariant: Window boundaries and equal-time arrival/prediction ties match the contract.
narrative: Prediction at 10:00 with a 2 h window, so the window is (08:00, 10:00]. e1 is measured and available at exactly 10:00: included on both counts. e2 is measured at exactly 08:00: excluded, the lower bound is open. e3 is one microsecond inside: included. e4 becomes available one microsecond after 10:00: excluded as-known. e5 is measured one microsecond after 10:00: excluded by every policy (its availability of 09:00 precedes its event time, which is reported as a warning and changes nothing). As-known: e1 and e3, mean (1.0 + 3.0) / 2 = 2.0, last is e1. Naive adds e4: mean 8 / 3.
